change_title: Change in percentage points from {from} to {to}
compare_unpaired: No candidate or party appears in both elections.
lede_same: {name} led both times, by {first} points in {from} and by {second} in {to}.
lede_changed: {first} led by {firstMargin} points in {from}; {second} led by {secondMargin} in {to}.
quality_exact_detail: Both elections report results for exactly this area, so every figure compares like with like.
quality_estimated_detail: At least one election is re-aggregated onto this area, so its figures are estimates.
match_party_detail: One row per party, following renamed and merged parties across years.
match_family_detail: One row per party family, so allied and successor parties count together.
shift_title: Change in the margin between {first} and {second} from {from} to {to}
term_valid: Ballots counted for a candidate, party, or answer. Blank and spoiled ballots are excluded.
term_list_votes: Votes cast for a party's list, which determine how seats are shared among parties.
term_electoral_votes: Votes cast by presidential electors. A candidate wins by receiving a majority of appointed electors.
term_state_delegate_equivalents: The weighted delegate count a caucus reports instead of votes.
term_options: Candidates, parties, or answers with results in this contest.
term_margin: The difference between the leader's share and the runner-up's share, in percentage points.
term_flips: Places led by a different candidate or party in each election.
term_shown: The result set displayed on this page. Other sets are listed for reference.
term_checks: Tests to ensure each place's figures are consistent, such as valid votes never exceeding ballots cast.
term_stage_live: Partial results published while the count is underway.
term_stage_preliminary: An early count published before final checks.
term_stage_official: The count published by the election authority.
term_stage_certified: The final count, formally certified by the election authority.
term_stage_court_revised: A count changed by a court ruling.
term_stage_recount: A count repeated after the initial count.
term_stage_alternative: A count from a source other than the election authority, such as volunteer observers.

match.seatsPlural=*: {seats} seats filled from ranked party lists

lists_elsewhere_detail: Took a seat in {contest} instead; this list skipped them.
lists_change_reason: {successor} took the seat of {predecessor}, who {reason}, on {date}.
term_cut: The line after the last member elected from a list. Members above it took the list's seats in rank order.
term_next: The first member below the cut line who stayed in the race. They would take the next seat this list won.
term_withdrew_fallback: Left the race after the lists were final. Their name stayed on the list and the seat went to the next member.
term_boundaries_approximate: These shapes are reconstructed from other geography, such as historic counties and town locations, instead of surveyed boundary maps. Borders are approximate.
group_option_detail: Show each party or candidate on its own row.
group_alliance_detail: Fold parties that ran together in an alliance or coalition into one row. Alliances that recur in other elections match by their largest party.
home_lede: Archiving {elections} elections from {first} to {last}, starting with these countries.

workbench_scatter_needs: Turn on Compare with previous to plot each place's shift.
workbench_shared: Shared with you. Save a copy to keep your changes.
workbench_missing: View doesn't exist or hasn't been shared by its owner.
workbench_save_failed: Failed to save view. Try again.
workbench_arrange_hint: Drag to move. Use arrow keys to move the view, or Shift and arrow keys to resize it.
workbench_delete_description: This cannot be undone. Any shared links to this view will stop working.
workbench_no_places: This contest has no results below its own level.

map_hint: Use arrow keys to move between places and Enter to open one.
map_gesture_windows: Hold Ctrl and scroll to zoom
map_gesture_mobile: Use two fingers to move the map
map_bubbles_key: Circles sized by {votes}, colored by winner
scatter_lede: Each circle is a place, sized by votes. The horizontal axis shows the margin between {a} and {b} in {from}; the vertical axis shows how much that margin shifted by {to}. Ringed circles changed hands.
scatter_label: {noun} margin in {from} vs. margin shift by {to}
scatter_movers_note: Change in the margin between the top two from {from} to {to}, in points.
seats_coalition_hint: Select parties to build a coalition.
seats_coalition_over: seats, a majority with {spare} to spare
tiers_lede: Governors, legislatures, and ballot measures decided in each {noun} on the same day.
tiers_parts_key: Colored by the winner of the {race} in each {noun}.
tiers_chamber_key: Colored by the party that won the most seats; darker shades indicate a larger share.
tiers_measure_key: Darker shades indicate more measures passed.
seats_paths_lede: Smallest combinations of parties that reach {count} seats, ordered by proximity on the left-right spectrum. Select a combination to highlight its seats.
regions_lede: Seats won by each party in each {noun}. Select a party to sort by seat count.
versus_lede: Compare two people or two places side by side to see how they fared in shared elections.
versus_mismatch: Choose two people or two places. You cannot compare a person with a place.
versus_places_none: These two places never voted in the same contest in the archive.
versus_margin_key: Above the line, {first} led; below it, {second} led.
versus_questions_key: The percentage of 'yes' votes in each place.
versus_head_none: They never ran in the same contest.
versus_shares_lede: Every recorded race for both. Filled marks are wins and hollow marks are losses.
governments_lede: The government in office on election day and all governments formed before the next general election.
chamber_makeup_seated: Seats each party held at the start of every term, based on those who actually sat. The dashed line marks a majority. Select a term to view details below.
chamber_makeup_results: Seats each party won at every general election. The dashed line marks a majority. Select a term to view details below.
chamber_majority: {party} held a majority with {seats} of {total} seats.
chamber_plurality: No party held a majority. The largest, {party}, had {seats} of {total} seats.
chamber_no_election: No election record for this term.
chamber_changes_none: No members joined or left during this term.
chamber_members_lede: Each bar shows a member's time in the chamber during the term.
chamber_makeup_mixed: Seats each party held at the start of every term: from records of those who actually sat where available, and from election results otherwise. The dashed line marks a majority. Select a term to view details below.
race_after: After the election, {party} held {seats} of the {total} seats.
race_after_tied: After the election, {party} and {runner} held {seats} of the {total} seats each.
error_404_body: The link may be out of date, or the place or election may go by a different name. Search the archive or start from a country on the home page.
error_500_body: The page failed to load. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, search for what you were looking for.
error_429_body: You have made too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
polity_versus_lede: Margins in {place} next to {parent} as a whole for the two most recent shared races.
party_strength_lede: Share of the vote by {noun} in the {race}. Darker colors indicate a larger share.
scrubber_lede: Drag the years or press play to see maps, the elected chamber, and the resulting government.
home_scrub_quiet: No general elections on record this year
home_scrub_hint: Drag the slider to see how the archive grows over time.
map_pick_touch: Tap a place to see its results.
provenance_scan: Digitized from page {page} of {title}. The highlighted box marks the number.
provenance_crop_alt: Scan of page {page} with the number highlighted
provenance_parts: This total is the sum of figures from {count} smaller places, each digitized from a printed page. The first is shown.
provenance_file: This number came from a machine-readable file; no page scan is available.
method_share: Share is the option's votes divided by all valid votes in the same place.
method_seats: Seats are recorded exactly as declared by the authority. The archive does not recalculate them.
method_swing: Swing is the change in the gap between the top two options from one election to the next, in percentage points.
method_stage: When multiple counts exist, the page shows the most final: certified, official, or preliminary.
winners_lede: Shows winners of all {count} races, grouped by {noun}, and the party with the most wins in each.
